analogy.rationale: Lipid peroxidase inhibitors block lipid peroxidation, overlapping with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms that reduce oxidative stress; however, these cells are not neuronal and the transcriptional signature of such cytoprotective mechanisms is typically weak at 6-24 h.
